title: This is a HUGE SHIFT
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: Huge debt raises (SpaceX $40B for Nvidia chips) and high-yield preferreds pull money from stocks short term.
Trump is posturing; expects a deal announced roughly Oct 20-27, before the Oct 28 Fed meeting, so gas prices fall before the election.
10y yield slope has flattened since ~Sep 27; maintains ~5.27% as peak yields; falling yields would lift stocks.
Record-poor breadth (51% of Russell 3000 down >20% since June) driven by Fed hawkishness should reverse as yields ease.

calls.reason: QQQ held well above his 748 line despite the SpaceX debt news; flattening 10y and a coming Iran deal set up a bullish move.
calls.quote: The bottom line of all of this clown show is the market going to go up.

calls.reason: Yield slope has flattened (foot off the accelerator); restates his ~5.27% peak-yield call; Morgan Stanley's Wilson says bonds overly hawkish.
calls.quote: I still maintain that around this level I I called 527 peak Treasury yields.

calls.condition: If an Iran deal is struck in the Oct 20-27 window as he expects.
calls.reason: Expects Trump to time an Iran deal so gas prices fall before the midterms (implied lower oil).
calls.quote: Ideal time frame for gas prices to fall before the election and Fed to hold. That would be my guess.

notes: Date: Kevin says 'There are 27 days left before the election' (US midterms Tue 2026-11-03), giving Wed 2026-10-07; listing approx_date (2026-10-08, '23 hours ago') looks a day late. Oil bias is implied from the gas-price/deal thesis, not a stated oil forecast. '527' read as 5.27% yield.
